entries.e2023c628831d7dd: Its basic policy is to 'provide high-quality medical and nursing care services to more people,' and it runs a business focused on medical and nursing care. In April 2025, the company formulated a medium-term management plan and set a target of ¥60 billion in revenue for the fiscal year ending February 2028. As issues to address, the company says it will work on 3 items: expanding its 3 core businesses (pharmacy dispensing, healthcare and pharmaceutical wholesale), strengthening earnings through efficient management, and developing human resources.
